crossrefs.text: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances—for the man who does these things will live by them.
For concerning the righteousness that is by the law, Moses writes: “The man who does these things will live by them.”
The law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, “The man who does these things will live by them.”
You must not bow down to their gods or serve them or follow their practices. Instead, you are to demolish them and smash their sacred stones to pieces.
You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
And I said to them: ‘Each of you must throw away the abominations before his eyes, and you must not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’

But they rebelled against Me and refused to listen. None of them cast away the abominations before their eyes, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the land of Egypt.
If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.
If a man lies with his fatherʼs wife, he has uncovered his fatherʼs nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his fatherʼs wife.
And Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.
And Jacob did just that. He finished the weekʼs celebration, and Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as his wife.

But Leah replied, “Is it not enough that you have taken away my husband? Now you want to take my sonʼs mandrakes as well?” “Very well,” said Rachel, “he may sleep with you tonight in exchange for your sonʼs mandrakes.”
While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his fatherʼs concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard about it. Jacob had twelve sons:
If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions. Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones.
Likewise, the men abandoned natural relations with women and burned with lust for one another. Men committed indecent acts with other men, and received in themselves the due penalty for their error.
Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts,
for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching

In like manner, Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, who indulged in sexual immorality and pursued strange flesh, are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire.
There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land. They imitated all the abominations of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
You must not bring the wages of a prostitute, whether female or male, into the house of the LORD your God to fulfill any vow, because both are detestable to the LORD your God.
For whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD. And because of these detestable things, the LORD your God is driving out the nations before you.
You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.

When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, do not imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.
